RagShortTexts: Warnings, familiar foothills and exits preserve Scirian manpower.
Auxiliary service needs agreed numbers, supplies and return dates.

Variants.Content: Warnings, familiar foothills and exits preserve people. Auxiliary service needs numbers, provisions and return dates; empty land cannot feed guards.

Warnings, familiar foothills and exits preserve Scirian manpower. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Auxiliary service needs agreed numbers, supplies and return dates.

Auxiliary service needs agreed numbers, supplies and return dates. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Warnings, familiar foothills and exits preserve Scirian manpower.

Warnings, familiar foothills and exits preserve Scirian manpower. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Auxiliary service needs agreed numbers, supplies and return dates.

Auxiliary service needs agreed numbers, supplies and return dates. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Warnings, familiar foothills and exits preserve Scirian manpower.
